text: とうちゃん　ウソばっかりで　あそびに　いかせて　くれん

structure.jp: あそびに　いかせて　くれん
structure.en: won't let me go out to play

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending on a verb means letting or making someone do it. いかせて is that form of いく (to go). いかせて = 'letting (me) go'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form verb says someone does it as a favour for the speaker. くれん is the dialect form of くれない, 'won't'. いかせて　くれん = 'won't let me go'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.span: あそびに　いかせて
patterns.explanation: に before a verb of going tells what you are going for. あそびに　いかせて = 'letting me go to play'.
